outlook.statement: The opening up of food grains sector will enable the Woven Sacks industry to see better times again.
The company is taking positive steps to move further for survival and development.

risks: Industry threatened by non-existence of exports to European Union due to heavy antidumping duty levied on Indian products
Intense competition due to major petrochemical manufacturers making available cheap raw material abundantly
Indifferent monsoon during last few years and general recessionary economies hitting performance of core sectors
